scope: Walk-forward family classifier ranking, original fit-cohort top-k budgets, token capture evidence and automatic runner advisory generation/consumption. No operational run or active model/policy training/promotion.
grain: One OOS decision scored by one original fitted model; its original test-fold identifier is retained for selection. All decisions of the same case-sensitive mint still form one token bootstrap mean.

findings.evidence: Native family classifier approval accepted a controlled scorer constant inside each of three100-row OOS windows. Their positive prevalences90/50/10 percent and scores0.9/0.5/0.1 produced pooled precision0.9 and token capture lift1.8, lower historical gain0.02965, although no token was distinguishable within any window. Initial native family assertion failed in2.76s.
findings.risk: Pooling raw rank scores from different fitted models creates a competition that never existed at one decision epoch. Between-window prevalence or score scale can masquerade as scanner token-selection skill. This is a synthetic software approval defect, not an observed financial loss.
findings.repair: Retain original evaluated fold IDs. Calculate exact-tie top-k selection and same-budget baseline within each original scoring cohort, then aggregate selected positives and one mean per mint.

method.capacity: For each original fit cohort c, k_c=max(1,round(n_c*pct)); exact boundary ties share the remaining capacity. Precision/recall aggregate actual selected-positive expectations. A supplied incumbent is evaluated at the same cohort capacities.
method.token_utility: Captured-positive y*w and uniform y*k_c/n_c are averaged per case-sensitive trimmed mint before the existing paired1000-sample token-cluster bootstrap. Total capacity_fraction is sum(k_c)/sum(n_c), not a substitute for each row's own baseline.
method.boundary: The actual forward producer assigns the original window enumeration even when a one-class training window is skipped. These are model-fit score units, not an independently attested full executing process.
method.metadata: Current version/selection scope, typed unique nonempty cohort IDs, rows/k conservation and total capacity consistency are required. Missing/partial/incompatible declarations remain unknown.
method.limits: Observed cohort cuts remain fixed in the bootstrap. This is not a time-block or creator-dependence test, does not prove future coverage and does not measure financial returns.
